name: Rootlace Amulet
description: A small amulet containing living Rootlace Mycelium in a sealed chamber — given to druids and attuned elves to maintain a subtle continuous read of the Feywood's root-memory network.
narrative_effects: Supports attentional practice by providing a very subtle ambient-field signal the bearer learns to read over months of carry.
Not magical in a flashy sense; the effect is relational — a trained bearer notices the Feywood's state shifts slightly earlier than they otherwise would.
Cannot function outside the Feywood's immediate ambient-field reach; realm-side, the amulet's chamber goes dormant.

mechanical_effect.trigger: trained bearer has carried it for months and is within the Feywood's immediate ambient-field reach
mechanical_effect.applies_to: checks to notice Feywood ambient-field state shifts, root-memory signals, or subtle field changes slightly earlier than otherwise possible
mechanical_effect.does_not_apply: untrained or new bearers; realm-side use outside ambient-field reach; flashy detection, divination, or precise navigation beyond subtle field-sense
